main_body: Cherry-blossom tree: a large pink rounded canopy (rows 0-31) on a short brown trunk (rows 32-41) with a small grass patch at the base
top_band: No distinct flat top band. The canopy dome starts with dark magenta-plum rows 1-4 (L~59), then mid pinks, with the lightest pinks at rows 12-13 and 24-31. It reads as a rounded foliage volume seen from above, not a flat top.
evidence: The organic canopy is a domed mass with a visible upper surface and the lit lower canopy, and the trunk below it is the south face. The canopy is dark at the top and light at the bottom, so it carries no flat light top band. The canopy casts a dark shadow on the trunk (rows 32-40). It is a volumetric blob like the reference trees, not a front elevation, side view or flat plan, so it passes as a tree.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 11 distinct colours and a median of 5 colours per tile, against about 108 per tile and 427-567 colours in the references. Its pink ramp has 5 steps (plum, magenta, rose, light pink, pale pink), and the trunk and grass add only 2-3 flat tones. Outlines are tinted plum, not neutral (0% neutral edge pixels), and there are no flat 5x5 fills. The foliage clumping is coarse, with no per-leaf highlights or varied greens, and the trunk and grass are plain. Next to the richly textured references it looks much thinner and simpler.
